# Auto-Generated Fix Prompts

This folder contains Claude Code prompts auto-generated by the Night Audit Agent.

## How it works

1. The nightly audit runs 5 system agents + 3 persona tests
2. Critical and high severity findings are clustered by root cause
3. Claude generates a ready-to-launch prompt per cluster
4. Prompts are committed here and pushed to GitHub
5. Discord notification is sent with links

## Structure

```
auto/
  2026-06-18/
    PROMPT-1-fix-exposure.md
    PROMPT-2-caption-sync.md
    ...
  2026-06-19/
    ...
```

## How to use

1. Open the prompt `.md` file
2. Copy the full content
3. Paste into a Claude Code session
4. Let it run

Multiple prompts from the same night can be launched in parallel (separate Claude Code sessions).
